slides.headline: GTA VI SETS A $3.79B OPEN
slides.deck: Rockstar says Grand Theft Auto VI made $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales after 32.5 million pre-launch units. The record-setting debut makes the long-awaited Vice City crime saga a massive console event.
slides.subject: Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval

slides.headline: EMINEM SUIT EXPANDS
slides.deck: Eight Mile Style and Martin Affiliated added 108 alleged Suno outputs tied to 26 Eminem songs in an amended federal complaint. The filing keeps the publisher’s claims alive while the court weighs the broader copyright fight.
slides.subject: Eminem

slides.headline: GLORILLA SITTING ON HITS
slides.deck: GloRilla says she is sitting on “so many hits” and teased an elevated, summer-minded sophomore album without announcing a date. The post gives her two-year-old debut era its clearest next-chapter signal yet.
slides.subject: GloRilla

slides.headline: CAM'RON GETS OPTIMISTIC
slides.deck: Cam’ron released “Optimistic,” the first single and video from Cam’ron Presents: Frederica, now slated for early 2027. The project honors his late mother and is planned with a companion film.
slides.subject: Cam’ron

slides.headline: SNOOP WRAPS BIOPIC
slides.deck: Snoop Dogg posted that the last day of his Universal biopic shoot had arrived, closing principal photography on the film starring Jonathan Daviss. Craig Brewer directs, with the movie set for theaters in August 2027.
slides.subject: Snoop Dogg
